Name: Horse to Unicorn
Author: BoyDani
Description:
Installation directions:
1. Navigate to /Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Animals
2. Create a back-up of your vanilla horse.xnb by renaming it to horsebackup.xnb or anything like that.
3. Open the zip and put the horse.xnb I've provided into the folder. 
4. Done!

If you'd like to edit the horse further, I've provided the png.
